story: As a girl, Kunti received a mantra that could call any god to give her a child. She tested it on the sun god and had Karna, whom she set adrift on a river out of fear. Later, with the gods' help, she had Yudhishthira, Bhima and Arjuna, and raised the Pandavas through exile and danger.
belief: She is admired for her endurance and for her famous prayer asking Krishna for hardships, so that she would always remember God. Many lists count her among the Panchakanya.
turns: She kept Karna's birth secret until just before the war, so her sons fought their own brother. Her offhand words 'share it equally' made Draupadi the wife of all five brothers.
facts: Her birth name was Pritha, which is why Arjuna is called Partha.
Kunti's prayer appears in the Bhagavata Purana.
She died in a forest fire after retiring to the woods with Gandhari and Dhritarashtra.
